fusions.name: Staghorn Shard
fusions.desc: Snaps a branch off your own body and throws it; it deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Prop-Root Reef
fusions.desc: Raises a 5-tile line of encrusted stilt roots ahead of you for 6 seconds. It deals 10 damage to anything that crosses it, leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and slows it by 25% for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Drinking the Tide
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds, and 10 health at once.

fusions.name: Mangrove Stilts
fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank your health regenerates 15% faster, from silver you move 10% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
